{{Quote|Would you mind helping me out?  I really need a forward watch guard to keep the undead away from the entrance.|Sergeant Mika Horn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWAC" />}}
'''Mika Horn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All you need to do is stand guard outside the walls at the forward watch and warn us of mass attacks. It should be pretty easy. I haven't seen any mass attacks for a few hours now.|Sergeant Mika Horn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWAC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Mika Horn served as a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|trooper]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He used to wear a [[Rebel heavy battle armor/Legends|Rebel battle armor]].<ref name="SWG:FWAC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection. The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref>

[[File:Camp_Alpha_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Camp Alpha]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
The Rebel Alliance quickly discovered the accident on Dathomir and dispatched a small unit of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] to investigate the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and rescue survivors. However, the Rebel forces were soon attacked by undead stormtroopers and suffered heavy casualties. When some Rebel soldiers started to display symptoms of the sickness, the evacuation missions were aborted and the few remaining Rebels were stuck in the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:TD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Tripp D'jek|Dathomir}}</ref> Mika Horn eventually took shelter in [[Camp Alpha]],<ref name="SWG:FWAC" /> along with the [[TIE pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]]<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:DCACA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Canisters Around Camp Alpha|Dathomir}}</ref> Sergeant Mika Horn was in charge of the forward defense of the camp and used to recruit spacers who ventured into the Quarantine Zone to help him in that mission.<ref name="SWG:FWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mika Horn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FWAC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mika Horn was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
